simple.meaning: דֹּדָנִים (Dôdânîym) is a Hebrew word meaning “Dodanites , or descendants of a son of Javan.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: דֹּדָנִים (H1721) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 10:4, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דֹּדָנִים (H1721) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in דֹּדָנִים (H1721) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: דֹּדָנִים (Dôdânîym) / H1721 is traced through Genesis 10:4, 1 Chronicles 1:7 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
